MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The Eagles and Frankie Valli collections feel like natural next choices because I am looking for familiar older songs, much like my classic rock and mid-'60s compilations.",
    "Neil Diamond and Bread fit the gentle melodies and singer-songwriter appeal I enjoy in Simon & Garfunkel and Jonathan Edwards."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "In The Lonely Hour and 25 lean toward contemporary pop and ballads, while I currently want older hits; having listened to Born This Way does not make newer pop my first choice today.",
    "Number One Hits and The Greatest Hits Collection do not identify an artist, so I cannot tell whether they contain the familiar music I want.",
    "Santana fits my classic rock interests, but I would choose the Eagles first today; a plausible match does not always mean I want to select it now."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "A greatest-hits title seems to count too heavily when the artist and songs are what determine whether I would enjoy the collection.",
    "My occasional interest in newer pop or vocal albums seems to have been taken as a broader preference than it is right now."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My repeated interest in older compilations points toward familiar '60s pop, classic rock, and melodic singer-songwriters.",
    "Cheek to Cheek makes a vocal album potentially appealing, but that connection alone is weaker than my current interest in older hits, especially when I am unsure who the performer is."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "You understood my interest in hits collections, but the strongest matches depend on familiar artists, older songs, and melodic styles rather than the collection label alone."
}
